tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Return whether the visitor is logged in on zinnov.com (via the ZURD cookie) and, if so, their profile fields useful for prefilling forms on the USA home page.

tools.name: logout_session
tools.description: Log the visitor out by clearing the ZURD session cookie. Call only when the user explicitly asks to sign out.

tools.name: submit_contact_request
tools.description: Submit a contact or "book a 30-min call" request from the USA home page. Requires a business email (no personal providers like Gmail). Returns the API response including success or validation errors.

businessEmail.description: Business email address. Personal/free providers (gmail, yahoo, outlook.com, etc.) are rejected.

priority.description: Biggest business priority / enquiry subject. Prefer one of: Set up a high-performing GCC in India; Transform my GCC; Explore the GCC Accelerator Platform; Win in Technology and Tech Services; Execute M&A; Maximize PE returns; Build, Assess and Augment my Partner Strategy.
enum: Set up a high-performing GCC in India
Win in Technology and Tech Services
Build, Assess and Augment my Partner Strategy

focusAreas.description: Optional focus areas refining the chosen priority.

tools.name: subscribe_to_insights
tools.description: Subscribe a business email to Zinnov's latest insights newsletter from the USA home page. Returns the API response (success, already subscribed, or validation errors).

email.description: Business email to subscribe. Personal/free providers are rejected.

tools.name: subscribe_to_podcast
tools.description: Subscribe to the Zinnov podcast from the USA home page. Requires name, business email, LinkedIn URL, and country/location. Optionally also opt into the insights newsletter.

email.description: Business email. Personal/free providers are rejected.

subscribeToNewsletter.description: Also subscribe this email to the Zinnov insights newsletter.
